boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3 RLCD
boards.note: Wi-Fi firmware required. Join the same network, then enter the board IP. iPhone hardware test pending.

boards.name: SparkFun XRP RP2350
boards.note: Wi-Fi firmware required. Actuator restrictions remain. iPhone hardware test pending.

boards.name: Adafruit Fruit Jam
boards.note: Board must already have joined Wi-Fi. Full power-cycle association limitations remain. iPhone test pending.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4 WIFI6
boards.note: Wireless programming unavailable: current manifest records a C6/hosting failure. Use the desktop USB editor.

boards.name: Propeller 2 — desktop USB
boards.note: USB serial only. Use the desktop editor. Direct iPhone USB serial and wireless programming are not implemented.

boards.name: Stock MicroBlocks BLE boards
boards.note: Safari on iPhone has no Web Bluetooth programming path here. Native CoreBluetooth support remains planned.

boards.name: Raspberry Pi 5 - desktop preview
boards.note: Use the existing desktop Linux preview for its board-specific blocks and loopback transport. This touch package supports offline general editing only.

boards.name: MicroDuck - desktop preview
boards.note: Use the existing desktop MicroDuck preview for Linux primitives and its host bridge. This touch package does not include that compiler extension or remote control.

boards.name: Arduino UNO Q - offline reference
boards.note: The desktop reference preview includes the UNO Q matrix input. This touch package provides general editing only; no UNO Q connection.
